title: European Parliament Robert Schuman Traineeship (March-July 2027 Session)
description: A five-month paid traineeship in the Secretariat of the European Parliament, giving hands-on exposure to EU legislative work. Around 800 Schuman trainees are selected each year across both annual sessions. Trainees are placed at one of Parliament's official places of work -- most commonly Brussels, but also Luxembourg, Strasbourg, or a Parliament Liaison Office in an EU member state -- assigned during the selection process rather than chosen by the applicant; this listing uses Brussels, the most common placement, as a representative destination. Selected trainees receive a monthly stipend of EUR 1,889 plus a EUR 300 travel allowance. Open to candidates worldwide, not just EU nationals. Applicants must hold a university-level diploma (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) obtained at least three months before the traineeship starts, plus thorough knowledge of one official EU language and very good knowledge of a second (English, French, or German recommended). This is the March-July 2027 session: applications aren't open yet -- the window runs 1-31 October 2026, for a traineeship running 1 March to 31 July 2027. The Parliament runs two sessions every year (October-February and March-July), each with its own application window roughly five months earlier.
visaNote: This is a short-term paid traineeship, not standard employment; non-EU nationals should confirm their own visa/residence requirements for a 5-month stay in Belgium (or wherever the placement is assigned) well ahead of the start date.
